text:
support-ops: FYI — customer Acme just escalated: p95 ~200ms -> p95 ~1.1s and p99 ~3s starting ~2026-03-10T10:15Z. Graphs: https://dash.redwood/acme/p95. No obvious infra outage.

alex: looking into traces now. any recent config changes to kv/prefix cache?

marta: we rolled a runtime tweak yesterday to reduce prefix TTL for memory pressure (flag: `prefix_ttl_seconds=30` -> 20). could that be it?

priya: quick log grep shows rising cold-miss ratio on kv: `kv.miss_rate.p95=0.58` and `kv.eviction.rate=0.41` for Acme tenant shard.

luke: stack traces from slow requests show repeated backend warmups: client request -> runtime misses -> model cold start? looks like repeated KV misses on same prefixes.

alex: paste of a snippet from the runtime metrics stream:```
[2026-03-10T10:16:21Z] WARN kv - tenant=acme shard=42 prefix_entropy=0.86 miss=0.73 evict_rate=0.37 warmup_hits=12 warmup_misses=98
[2026-03-10T10:16:22Z] INFO batcher - inflight=84 avg_latency_ms=920 p99_ms=3020
```

priya: hypothesis — TTL reduction + high prefix cardinality -> thrash. Also saw inconsistent key normalization for `X-Session` header: some requests include `session=abc` others `session=abc;v=1` -> different cache keys.

marta: good catch. we recently changed header passthrough ordering in the ingress proxy to preserve raw headers (was normalizing). that could create multiple cache keys for same logical session.

support-ops: we have repro steps from the customer load: they replayed a burst with ~500 tps of mixed header formats and saw p99 blow up immediately. they shared a minimal repro harness.

alex: can we reproduce locally quickly? I'll run the harness against staging kv with mixed headers. share the curl pattern.

support-ops:```
# repro script (simplified)
for i in `seq 1 500`; do
  if (( i % 2 == 0 )); then
    curl -s -H "X-Session: abc" https://staging.redwood/kv/fetch?prefix=acme:user:$((i%100)) &
  else
    curl -s -H "X-Session: abc;v=1" https://staging.redwood/kv/fetch?prefix=acme:user:$((i%100)) &
  fi
done
wait
```

luke: ran a quick local run — confirmed miss-rate jumps and eviction churn. Heap snapshots show many short-lived prefix entries.

alex: repro confirmed. two distinct problems: (1) header-derived key variance making logical the same prefix look different, (2) TTL too low + LRU eviction policy -> hotset churn.

priya: immediate mitigation option 1: revert prefix_ttl_seconds to previous value (30s) to stop thrash. Option 2: normalize header-derived keys in ingress (preferable long-term). Option 3: introduce short-term sticky warmup window to avoid immediate eviction for entries created within last N seconds.

marta: can we flip a runtime feature flag to enable key normalization and sticky warmup in staging? I can prepare a canary.

alex: prefer to do two-step: 1) emergency: set prefix_ttl_seconds=90 for Acme tenant via per-tenant override (limits blast radius) and enable sticky_warmup=true (warmup grace 120s). 2) follow up: ingress patch to normalize `X-Session` and other session-like headers.

support-ops: customer approved quick config change if it reduces tail latency.

deploy-bot: starting deploy: config-change acme/overrides prefix_ttl_seconds=90 sticky_warmup=120 by marta -> canary in eu-west-1

infra-bot: canary results 5m: p95 reduced from 1100ms -> 230ms, p99 from 3s -> 680ms for canary shard. miss_rate fell from 0.72 -> 0.18. no errors introduced.

marta: rolling to remaining Acme shards now. monitoring.

luke: next steps captured for postmortem: normalize header keys in proxy (PR #4728), add unit tests for header canonicalization, add e2e load test that mixes header formats.

priya: also adding a telemetry metric `kv.prefix_key_variants` to measure unique key variants per logical prefix over rolling window. will alert if > threshold.

alex: notes for follow-up rollout: patch to runtime eviction policy to prefer frequency+recency (2Q-LRU) to reduce cold oscillation under high cardinality. spike testing planned next week.

support-ops: ACME confirmed tail latency good after config change. they asked for timeline on permanent fix (header normalization + eviction policy).

marta: timeline: ingress PR in review today, target prod deploy in 3 days; runtime eviction change targets staging test in 7 days.

alex: created ticket INF-9241 with logs, repro script, canary run links, and proposed mitigations. assigning to @marta and @priya.

support-ops: thanks team. putting this in customer follow-up queue and will schedule a postmortem call. :thumbsup:

luke: quick reminder — put config overrides into the tenant-override audit log (already did) and include the change in next all-hands runbook update.

marta: added runbook blurb for "kv prefix thrash" with playbook steps:
- check `kv.miss_rate`, `kv.eviction.rate`
- grep for inconsistent header variants
- increase TTL or enable sticky_warmup per-tenant
- apply ingress header normalization
- monitor `kv.prefix_key_variants`

support-ops: closing loop here. will re-open if any regression.

priya: one small test note for infra: when running the repro harness locally, add a small splay (`sleep $((RANDOM%10))`) to avoid synchronized bursts which can overstate thrash during real traffic.

alex: thanks all — solid incident. +1 on the metrics addition.
